name: VRM_RECUR_SRC_DATA_GT
description: VRM_RECUR_SRC_DATA_GT contains information about recurring source data during the renewal processing.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: System-generated unique key for the source document line. Examples of source document lines include sales order lines, invoice lines, project lines, and service contract lines.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Source document identifier of the line.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Source document group identifier used to group the initial recurring source document header and system-generated recurring source document headers. Value is the source document identifier for the original source document.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_DATE
columns.description: Date of the source document, such as the book date for a sales order, or the invoice date for an invoice.

columns.name: PLAN_START_DATE
columns.description: Revenue recoginition start date for revenue rule types, such as daily revenue rate, all periods or daily revenue rate, and partial periods.

columns.name: PLAN_END_DATE
columns.description: Revenue recoginition end date for revenue rule types, such as daily revenue rate, all periods or daily revenue rate, and partial periods.

columns.name: LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Selling amount on a source document line.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity of inventory item or memo line on a source document line.

columns.name: UNIT_SELLING_PRICE
columns.description: Selling price per unit of measure of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: COST_AMOUNT
columns.description: Cost of inventory item or memo line. This column is used to calculate the gross margin percentage.

columns.name: GROSS_MARGIN_PERCENT
columns.description: Gross margin percentage for the source document line.  This column is used in standalone selling price computation for the gross margin percentage standalone selling price representation type.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Code indicating the measure of the inventory item or memo line.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_RULE_DURATION
columns.description: Number of periods in which revenue is to be recognized.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_RULE_ID
columns.description: Revenue scheduling rule identifier on the source document line. The revenue scheduling rule determines the timing of revenue recognition.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_RULE_NAME
columns.description: Revenue scheduling rule name on the source document line. The revenue scheduling rule determines the timing of revenue recognition.

columns.name: RECURRING_PATTERN_CODE
columns.description: Recurring frequency of the line. Valid values are from the lookup type VRM_RECUR_PATTERN_CODE.

columns.name: RECURRING_AMOUNT
columns.description: Selling amount per frequency for the recurring line.

columns.name: RECURRING_FREQUENCY
columns.description: Frequency number of the recurring pattern.

columns.name: TERMINATION_DATE
columns.description: Date the line was terminated and will no longer recur automatically.

columns.name: LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Source document recurring line type. Valid values are Terminated Line if the line has a past termination date, Active Line if the termination date is in the future, or blank.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Ledger identifier of source document.

columns.name: CONTRACT_GROUP_NUMBER
columns.description: Concatenation of the original customer contract's source document number and customer contract number for the recurring line.

columns.name: RECUR_HEADER_COPY_NUM
columns.description: Number of times the recurring source document header was copied.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the source document line. The value corresponds with the currency code values available in Oracle Fusion General Ledger.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_1
columns.description: First numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_2
columns.description: Second numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_3
columns.description: Third numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_4
columns.description: Fourth numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_INT_5
columns.description: Fifth numeric column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_CHAR_1
columns.description: First character column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_CHAR_2
columns.description: Second character column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_CHAR_3
columns.description: Third character column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_CHAR_4
columns.description: Fourth character column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOC_LINE_ID_CHAR_5
columns.description: Fifth character column of the key that identifies source document line in source application.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Source document type identifier of various source systems which integrate with revenue management.

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.description: Source application of document data to identify source document sub line. Each integrating application has a unique value, such as EBIZ.

columns.name: RECUR_LINE_COPY_NUM
columns.description: Sequence number of the recurring source document line.
